evidence_supported.biphasic_temperature: postovulatory finger-temperature elevation is supported by Oura studies; 0.3..0.7C is the reference range used here
evidence_supported.fertile_label: six-day interval ending on ovulation day
evidence_supported.staging: bleeding history, not ring physiology alone, defines STRAW+10 staging

interpretation: Joint distributions, stage separability, hormone status and observation errors have not been estimated from representative ring cohorts. High synthetic metrics test recovery of these assumptions, not real physiology. A domain-shift stress test is still synthetic, not external validation.
